title: Integral generic ideal lattice construction
statement: For an integral Noetherian scheme Z and coherent module G, there exist r and an ideal sheaf I, both I and the coproduct of r copies of I coherent, and a morphism χ from that coproduct to G whose generic stalk map is an isomorphism.

proof.text: Choose r, U, hx and φ by the finite generic-basis neighbourhood theorem.
Extend that specific φ from a coherent ideal lattice, retaining r, to obtain I and χ with invertible generic stalk.
Apply the proved finite-coproduct coherence theorem to I and r and assemble the existential witnesses and conjunctions.

proof_origin.place: Tag 01YE, integral case; X2 reduction into generic basis, ideal extension, and proved finite-sum coherence

lean.statement:
theorem coherent_integral_generic_ideal_construction (Z : Scheme.{w}) [IsNoetherian Z]
    [IsIntegral Z] (G : Z.Modules) (hG : RingedSpace.IsCoherent Z.toRingedSpace G) :
    ∃ (r : ℕ) (I : Z.IdealSheafData),
      RingedSpace.IsCoherent Z.toRingedSpace I.toModules ∧
      RingedSpace.IsCoherent Z.toRingedSpace (∐ fun _ : Fin r => I.toModules) ∧
      ∃ (χ : (∐ fun _ : Fin r => I.toModules) ⟶ G),
        IsIso ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor Z.toRingedSpace (genericPoint Z)).map χ)
